piece_type: DTC TV ad “TV 0:60 STORYBOARD: FEEL/SEE BASKETBALL” (3500-US-2500152)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “Back to the game I love.” | “It’s great to be able to keep up with the guys again.” | “With CAMZYOS my symptoms have improved and I can be more active now.” | “It’s a difference I can feel…” | “… and they can see.” | “And she can too.” | “It’s great to be playing again.”
cases.context: Basketball, being lightly tackled, lifting child overhead. PI EXPLORER-HCM: 37% vs 17% met primary endpoint at Week 30. Disclaimer “Individual results may vary.”
cases.rationale: Implies all oHCM patients can expect this activity level with little to no restriction — not demonstrated.
cases.check: Judge: depicted activity level vs. responder rate in PI; flag implication that 'all patients' achieve it.

cases.claim: “CAMZYOS works by targeting what’s causing oHCM”
cases.context: PI: “Mavacamten is an allosteric and reversible inhibitor selective for cardiac myosin”.
cases.rationale: Vague phrase suggests correction of underlying genetic defects.
cases.check: Judge: 'targets the cause/root cause' MoA language vs. PI Clinical Pharmacology wording.

cases.claim: [Omission] Major statement omits MG: “Are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. CAMZYOS may harm your unborn baby . . . . ”
cases.check: Rule: diff major statement against W&P list and MG 'tell your HCP' items.

cases.cat: Lack of fair balance / risk prominence
cases.claim: [Format] text portion of major statement: size and style of font, contrast with background, and placement on screen do not allow easy reading
cases.check: Rule: measure SUPER font size, contrast ratio and placement against legibility thresholds.

cases.claim: [Visual] friends stretching and moving, greeting friends in the park, wife and daughter petting a dog, playing basketball with daughter — with frequent scene changes during the major statement
cases.check: Storyboard check: flag attention-grabbing visuals and frequent scene changes during major statement audio.
